title.fr: Équilibre d'un solide soumis à trois forces

sketch:
Observe: SVG scene of a ring pulled by 3 strings at variable angles
with weights on pulleys. Student drags string angles; force arrows
F₁, F₂, F₃ redraw as a closed triangle (dynamique) when equilibrium
holds; an open triangle shows out-of-equilibrium. HUD reads ΣF and
closure gap. Experiment: 3 seeded (F₁, F₂) pairs; student picks F₃
magnitude+direction to close the triangle. Evaluate: dynamique panel
hidden; student sets F₃ from component sums alone, submits, then
triangle is revealed on feedback.
